title: Build AI trading agents in seconds
author: Charming-Patient8102
selftext:
As a college student, I've always wanted to have my own little army of analysts which go out and place trades based on market conditions. I don't really have the time or inclination however to spend hours watching Robinhood and X to get market insight. 

  
I recently came across this app called Delphi which is completely free and lets me create strategies just by typing that I can then test and deploy. Thought I'd share to help anyone else out there who has had the same problem.
